title: Managing the Abstraction
coreMove: Pause the process at the point where it would close and reopen contact with the human consequence underneath.
sourcePressure: Turns abstraction into discipline: reports, rules, and categories remain useful only when leaders reconnect them to lived human consequence before judgment hardens.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making this a generic balanced leadership chapter, or rejecting processes rather than keeping them subordinate to judgment.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
